response.overview: Rain Keeper is a heartfelt 3D animated short film created by a small group called EhSthetics. It’s about how a simple act of kindness can change lives. The story follows Andersun, an elderly café owner struggling to keep his family business alive, and Rae, a young social media influencer. One gloomy evening, Rae visits Andersun’s nearly empty café and he was thrilled to finally serve a customer after so long. However, Rae remained distracted the entire time on her phone and ignored his presence. Suddenly, she receives an urgent message, forcing her to leave but she was trapped by the heavy rain outside. Despite their brief and distant interaction, Andersun kindly lends her his umbrella without hesitation. Touched by his sincerity and hospitality, Rae secretly uses her online platform to promote the hidden café. Slowly, customers begin returning, bringing life back to the place Andersun thought he had already lost.
response.title: Rain Keeper
